clue.text: They are linked with land measures

definitions.meaning: a series of linked rings forms a fetter or necklace
a surveyor's measure of 22 yards, used for land

explanation.surface: Something tied up with the business of measuring land.

clue.text: Finally decide

definitions.meaning: read as a verb sense: to end or wind up
to reach a judgment after reasoning

explanation.surface: Coming at last to a decision.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring to an end, and to arrive at a judgment by reasoning.

clue.text: Value a quiet expression of approval

parts.note: P is the musical abbreviation for piano, quietly
praise is spoken approval

explanation.surface: Assessing what a quiet word of approval is worth.
explanation.definitionFit: To put a price on or estimate the worth of something; a verb synonym.

clue.text: When a division is called for, they won't agree

definitions.text: When a division is called for, they won't agree

parts.words: When a division is called for, they won't agree
parts.note: in Parliament a division is a formal vote, and the members voting against are counted in their own lobby

explanation.surface: Arithmetic pupils refusing a sum, though really a parliamentary vote.
explanation.walkthrough: A division in the UK Parliament is a vote in which members file through lobbies; those against are counted as one side.
explanation.definitionFit: Votes cast against a motion are recorded under this name in parliamentary divisions.

clue.text: Strange relics to be found in the cathedral

indicators.note: strange suggests the letters of the two words are in an odd, rearranged order

explanation.surface: Unusual holy relics are discovered within a cathedral.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Strange' rearranges the letters of RELICS and TO together.
explanation.definitionFit: A covered arcade round a quadrangle is a typical feature of a cathedral or monastery.

clue.text: Induced to become religious?

definitions.meaning: persuaded or caused to think something
read literally, steered towards holding a faith

explanation.surface: Someone persuaded into joining a faith.
explanation.definitionFit: Persuaded to accept something as true; and, taken literally, guided into faith as a new believer.

clue.text: Press in or out

indicators.note: out signals that the letters of the two little words are put out of their usual order

explanation.surface: Push something inward or outward.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the four letters of IN and OR.
explanation.definitionFit: To smooth clothes with a hot appliance is to press them.

clue.text: Three times they initially faced new peril

indicators.note: initially means take only the opening letter of the word they
new indicates the word peril is made into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: On three occasions a group confronted fresh danger.
explanation.walkthrough: 'initially' gives T from 'they'; 'new' rearranges PERIL into RIPLE; 'faced' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Threefold, multiplied by three.

clue.text: Stew has her way of using left-overs

indicators.note: to stew is to cook in a mixed jumble, so the letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A woman's stew is how she uses up the remains of a meal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Stew' looks like the dish but is the anagram signal, rearranging HAS HER.
explanation.definitionFit: Serving old material again in new form, as cooks do with leftover food.

clue.text: Fancied to win but dropped off

definitions.meaning: a racing tipster's nap is the day's strongest tip, so a horse tipped this way is fancied
fell briefly asleep

explanation.surface: A favourite that fell asleep instead of winning.
explanation.walkthrough: In British racing journalism a nap is a tipster's best bet of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: A tipster's top selection is so marked; the same word means having dozed.

clue.text: Warn a pretty girl about a Scotsman

indicators.note: about means the girl goes around the Scotsman

parts.note: dish is slang for an attractive person
Mon is a stock word for a Scot, from Scots dialect for man

explanation.surface: Cautioning an attractive woman about a man from Scotland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'pretty girl' as DISH is old slang for an attractive person; MON is the stock crossword Scot.
explanation.definitionFit: To reprove or caution someone firmly.

clue.text: Remedy for one who has become distressed?

definitions.text: Remedy for one who has become distressed?

parts.words: Remedy for one who has become distressed?
parts.note: distressed is read as de-tressed, someone who has lost their locks

explanation.surface: A cure for someone who is upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'distressed' means upset on the surface, but splits as dis-tressed: deprived of tresses.
explanation.definitionFit: A tonic claimed to regrow the locks of the balding.

clue.text: Go ahead with the roof covering

definitions.meaning: to be in front
the soft grey metal used for roofing sheets

explanation.surface: Proceeding with the job of covering a roof.

clue.text: Carry on playing for the club

definitions.meaning: in cricket, to continue an innings is to ...
a stick such as a police truncheon

explanation.surface: Continuing to play on behalf of the team.
explanation.walkthrough: The first sense reads as two words, bat on; cricket batters bat on when they continue their innings.
explanation.definitionFit: A short stick or truncheon; and, split in two, continuing to bat in cricket.

clue.text: A girl finally loses direction, sad to say

indicators.note: finally loses means a compass point is dropped from the end of the word

parts.note: lass is a word for a girl
S is the compass abbreviation for south

explanation.surface: A young woman ends up lost, unfortunately.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally loses' takes the last S (south) off LASS.
explanation.definitionFit: An interjection of regret, used like unfortunately.

clue.text: It's essential to a helicopter going up or down

indicators.note: in a down clue this says the word reads the same upwards as downwards

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A vital part of a helicopter as it rises or descends.
explanation.walkthrough: 'going up or down' tells you the word is the same read either way in the column.
explanation.definitionFit: The spinning blade assembly that lifts the aircraft.

clue.text: Verminous vehicle

definitions.meaning: infested with insects
a light carriage or pushchair

explanation.surface: A carriage infested with pests.
explanation.definitionFit: Full of insects; and a light carriage or pushchair.

clue.text: Broadcasting studio source is somewhat rude

indicators.note: broadcasting means scattering widely, so the letters are spread into a new order

explanation.surface: A radio studio's source is a little impolite.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Broadcasting' fits the studio scene but rearranges STUDIO SOURCE.
explanation.definitionFit: Lacking politeness; impolite.

clue.text: A singer to object to one wrong note

parts.note: to bar is to prohibit or object to
I is the Roman numeral for one

indicators.note: wrong signals the letters of note are set in an incorrect order

explanation.surface: A vocalist protesting at a single false note.
explanation.definitionFit: A male vocalist whose range lies between bass and tenor.

clue.text: Person or instrument making notes

definitions.meaning: someone who writes things down, or a judge in certain courts
a woodwind pipe, or a device taking down sound

explanation.surface: Someone or something that writes down notes.
explanation.definitionFit: One who takes written records, and a woodwind pipe that sounds musical notes.

clue.text: The height of wrath?

parts.note: height is read literally as tallness, so the peak of anger is pictured as lofty

explanation.surface: The pinnacle of anger.
explanation.definitionFit: A furious temper, with the adjective meaning both extreme and very tall.

clue.text: Greek god, part herald, part messenger

parts.note: the opening portion of the word herald
the opening portion of the word messenger

explanation.surface: A Greek deity who is partly announcer, partly courier.
explanation.walkthrough: The god is himself the messenger of the gods, so the surface fits.
explanation.definitionFit: The Olympian messenger deity, son of Zeus.

clue.text: Working out Easter may be a problem

indicators.note: working out suggests the letters of Easter are worked into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Calculating the date of Easter can be tricky.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Working out' rearranges EASTER; 'may be a' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A puzzle or brain-twister is a difficult problem.

clue.text: It's still a woman's name

parts.note: Eve is a woman's name, the first woman in Genesis

explanation.surface: This remains a female name.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a girl's name for the whole answer; the woman gives only EVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Used as an adverb meaning yet, as in still better.

clue.text: Two ways to get staff

parts.note: ST is short for street, a way
AVE is short for avenue, another way

explanation.surface: There are two methods of hiring employees.
explanation.definitionFit: A wooden staff or stick, or the set of lines music is written on.

clue.text: Take hat round beach near Venice

parts.note: lid is slang for a hat
O is round in shape

explanation.surface: Collecting money in a hat on the shore near Venice.
explanation.walkthrough: The Lido is the long sandbar beach off Venice.
explanation.definitionFit: The famous bathing beach on the barrier island near Venice.

clue.text: Boot bag

definitions.meaning: to boot is to dismiss from work
a large coarse bag

explanation.surface: A bag for boots.
explanation.definitionFit: To dismiss from a job; and a large sturdy bag.

clue.text: She's found in a wild rave

indicators.note: wild indicates the letters of rave are thrown into disorder

explanation.surface: A woman discovered at an unruly party.
explanation.definitionFit: A woman's given name stands for any woman here.

clue.text: Slaughter in the service area

parts.note: Mass is a church service
an acre is a unit of area

explanation.surface: Killing within the area where a service is held.
explanation.definitionFit: Indiscriminate killing of many people.

clue.text: Instant support

definitions.meaning: a very short moment
to back a motion or a person

explanation.surface: Immediate backing.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief moment; and to back a proposal formally.

clue.text: The batsmen out

definitions.meaning: in cricket the batter facing the bowling is the one on strike
workers who have walked out in a dispute

explanation.surface: The cricket batters have been dismissed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' looks like cricket dismissal but means workers out on strike.
explanation.definitionFit: Batters facing bowling in cricket, and workers who have walked out in protest.

clue.text: Rush into a job for life

definitions.meaning: to move headlong and fast
a lifelong profession

explanation.surface: Hurrying into permanent employment.
explanation.definitionFit: To hurtle along; and one's lifelong profession.
